main_body: Round leafy tree canopy (about rows 0-36) on a short brown trunk with a small grass patch at the base
top_band: none: the column at x=16 runs dark green (rows 0-5), then mixed mid greens, then lighter greens at rows 32-35 near the bottom of the canopy. There is no separate top band.
evidence: The subject is a tree, an organic rounded canopy mass. It is not a flat-faced architectural piece, so the top/front contract does not apply in the usual way. The canopy reads as a volume with clumped foliage, and the trunk and ground patch sit below it. There is no isometric side face and no flat elevation or plan. The tone ramp is slightly odd, with the lightest greens at the bottom, but it is a rounded mass and not a failing flat drawing.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 12 distinct colours and a median of 6 per tile, against 427-567 colours and a median of about 108 per tile in the references. The canopy shows about 5 green steps, with clumped dithering, but with so few colours the leaf clusters and trunk lack the per-clump highlights and varied greens of the references. The outline is a dark green tint (0% neutral) and flat-fill coverage is 0%, which are good. The trunk is a flat 2-3 tone brown, and the grass patch is simple. Next to the references it reads as clearly thinner and flatter, with much lower information density.
